name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
purpose: Generate self-employment through establishment of micro-enterprises in non-farm sector
description: PMEGP is a credit-linked subsidy programme that provides financial assistance to set up micro-enterprises. It offers a margin money subsidy of 15-35% of the project cost, with the balance arranged as a bank loan.
benefits: Margin money subsidy: 15% (urban general), 25% (rural general), 25% (urban SC/ST/OBC/minority/women/PwD/NER), 35% (rural SC/ST/OBC/minority/women/PwD/NER)
Loan up to ₹50 lakhs for manufacturing sector
Loan up to ₹20 lakhs for service/trading sector
No collateral required up to ₹10 lakhs (CGTMSE covered)
Free Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) training (2-week residential)

education.note: For projects above ₹10 lakhs (manufacturing) or ₹5 lakhs (service), 8th pass is required

existingBeneficiary.note: Existing PMEGP/PMRY/REGP beneficiaries not eligible for second loan under PMEGP

eligibilityCriteria.note: New enterprises only — existing units not eligible unless they are SC/ST/PwD/NER/aspirational district beneficiaries seeking upgradation

applicationRoute.offline: Nearest KVIC / KVIB / District Industries Centre (DIC) office

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana – Shishu
implementingAgency: MUDRA Ltd. / Scheduled Commercial Banks / MFIs / NBFCs
purpose: Provide micro-finance to very small / new businesses with funding needs up to ₹50,000
description: Shishu category under PMMY covers loans up to ₹50,000 for micro-entrepreneurs who are just starting or have very small funding needs. No collateral required. Available at all public sector banks, private banks, MFIs and NBFCs.
benefits: Loan up to ₹50,000
No collateral required
Repayment period 3–5 years
Competitive interest rates (typically 9–12% p.a.)
MUDRA Card (RuPay) for working capital flexibility
Available through 27+ lender types nationwide

existingBeneficiary.note: Can avail multiple times if previous loan is fully repaid

eligibilityCriteria.note: Non-farm income generating activities; excludes farm credit. Applicant must not have defaulted on any prior loan.

applicationRoute.offline: Any scheduled commercial bank, MFI, or NBFC branch

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana – Kishor
implementingAgency: MUDRA Ltd. / Scheduled Commercial Banks / MFIs / NBFCs
purpose: Provide working capital and term loan to growing micro-enterprises requiring ₹50,001 to ₹5 lakhs
description: Kishor covers enterprises that have moved past the startup phase and need larger financing for expansion, equipment, or working capital. Lenders may require basic financials for existing businesses.
benefits: Loan ₹50,001 to ₹5 lakhs
No collateral up to ₹10 lakh (CGTMSE covered)
Flexible repayment up to 7 years
Can be used for machinery, working capital, or infrastructure
MUDRA Card for working capital

eligibilityCriteria.note: Existing businesses with some track record preferred. Bank may ask for last 1-year financials.

requiredDocuments: Business Proof (GST, Shop Act, trade licence, or self-declaration)
Existing Business Financials (P&L, balance sheet if available)

applicationRoute.offline: Any scheduled commercial bank, MFI, or NBFC branch

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
implementingAgency: Urban Local Bodies (ULB) / Scheduled Commercial Banks / MFIs / SHGs
purpose: Provide affordable working capital loans exclusively to street vendors to resume livelihood after COVID-19 disruption
description: PM SVANidhi is a special micro-credit scheme for street vendors operating in urban areas. It provides collateral-free loans starting at ₹10,000, with enhancement up to ₹50,000 upon timely repayment. Digital transactions earn cash-back rewards. A street vendor certificate or ULB registration is essential.
benefits: Initial loan of ₹10,000 (1st tranche)
Enhanced loan of ₹20,000 (2nd tranche, on timely repayment)
Further enhanced loan of ₹50,000 (3rd tranche)
No collateral required
Interest subsidy of 7% per annum on timely repayment
Digital transaction incentive up to ₹1,200 per year
Credit score building through formal banking channel

eligibilityCriteria.note: Applicant MUST be a street vendor operating in an urban area with a Certificate of Vending issued by ULB OR a Letter of Recommendation from ULB/TVC. Scheme is exclusively for street vendors.

requiredDocuments: Certificate of Vending (CoV) issued by ULB OR Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from ULB/TVC
Bank Account Passbook / Jan Dhan Account
Proof of Street Vending Activity (photos, self-declaration)

applicationRoute.offline: Nearest Urban Local Body (Municipal Corporation / Municipality) or lending institution

name: PM-DAKSH Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
implementingAgency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC) and similar bodies
purpose: Provide skill development and training to SC, OBC, Safai Karamcharis, Denotified Nomadic Tribes to enhance employability and self-employment
description: PM-DAKSH (Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi) is a skilling scheme for marginalized communities. It provides free short-term and long-term skill training, with stipend, toolkits, and placement assistance. Not a loan scheme — it is a training and capacity-building programme.
benefits: Free skill training (duration: 5 days to 1 year depending on course)
Stipend: ₹1,000/month to ₹1,500/month for residential training
Toolkit/material cost covered by government
Placement assistance after training completion
Certificate recognized by National Skill Qualification Framework (NSQF)
Covers trades: weaving, tailoring, beauty & wellness, food processing, electrical, plumbing, etc.

education.note: No minimum education required for most courses

eligibilityCriteria.note: Exclusively for SC and OBC categories (and Safai Karamcharis / DNT). OBC annual family income must be below ₹1 lakh; SC annual family income must be below ₹3 lakhs.

applicationRoute.offline: NSFDC / State Channelizing Agency / District Social Welfare Office
